description: Use this when someone asks how long until GTA 6 launches. Returns the confirmed release date (November 19, 2026, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), the days left, and the exact unlock moments for New Zealand, the United Kingdom and the US East Coast. Optional: an IANA time zone such as "Asia/Kolkata" for that zone's store unlock.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Chicago or Asia/Kolkata

name: get_launch_countdown
title: GTA 6 launch countdown
